## 🏗️ Tech Stack

### Backend (Java 17 + Spring Boot 3.2.0)
| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| **Framework** | Spring Boot 3.2.0 |
| **Auth** | Spring Security + JWT (jjwt 0.12.3, BCrypt) |
| **Database** | H2 in-memory (JPA/Hibernate, `ddl-auto=update`) |
| **API** | RESTful JSON over HTTP |
| **Export** | OpenCSV 5.9 |
| **Notifications** | Mock SMS (Twilio-ready), Mock Email (Spring Mail-ready) |
| **Build** | Maven, Java 17, fat JAR |

### Frontend (React 18 + Vite 5)
| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| **Framework** | React 18.2.0 |
| **Routing** | React Router DOM 6.21 |
| **HTTP** | Axios 1.6 |
| **Maps** | Leaflet 1.9.4 + react-leaflet 4.2.1 |
| **Charts** | Recharts 2.10 |
| **Export (client)** | jsPDF 4.2 + jsPDF-AutoTable, PapaParse 5.5 |
| **Toasts** | react-hot-toast 2.4 |
| **Build** | Vite 5 with proxy → `localhost:8080` |

---

## 🧠 Architecture & Data Flow

```
Browser  ──Vite proxy──►  Spring Boot :8080  ──►  H2 (in-memory)
  │                          │
  │  Axios + JWT Bearer      │ JPA Repository
  ▼                          ▼
React App              REST Controllers
  │                          │
  ├─ AuthContext ───────────► AuthController (login/register → JWT)
  ├─ Sidebar + Pages ──────► 16 Controllers
  └─ MapView (Leaflet) ────► Location/Drone APIs (5s polling)
```

---

## 📡 17 API Controllers (backend)

| Controller | Endpoint Prefix | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `AuthController` | `/api/auth` | Register, login → JWT token |
| `DisasterController` | `/api/disasters` | CRUD, status updates, user vs all |
| `HospitalController` | `/api/hospitals` | Full CRUD for hospitals |
| `ShelterController` | `/api/shelters` | Full CRUD for shelters |
| `VolunteerController` | `/api/volunteers` | CRUD + `GET /available` |
| `ResourceController` | `/api/resources` | CRUD + `GET /available` + `GET /disaster/{id}` |
| `DroneController` | `/api/drones` | CRUD + `PUT /{id}/location` (GPS update) |
| `ResourceRecommendationController` | `/api/recommendations` | AI resource optimization |
| `PredictionController` | `/api/predictions` | AI damage prediction |
| `WeatherController` | `/api/weather` | Weather data (mock if no API key) |
| `LocationController` | `/api/locations` | All locations + live drone simulation |
| `NotificationController` | `/api/notifications` | List, unread count, mark read |
| `AnalyticsController` | `/api/analytics` | Aggregated platform metrics |
| `AuditLogController` | `/api/audit-logs` | Activity history (admin-only) |
| `ExportController` | `/api/exports` | CSV/TXT/Excel export (admin-only) |
| `TimelineController` | `/api/timelines` | Status change history per disaster |

---

## 🗄️ 11 Database Entities

| Entity | Key Fields |
|---|---|
| **User** | id, username, email, password(hashed), role(USER/ADMIN) |
| **Disaster** | type(8 kinds), severity(4 levels), location, lat/lng, status(6 states), user FK, date |
| **StatusTimeline** | disaster FK, fromStatus, toStatus, changedBy, comment, timestamp |
| **Hospital** | name, beds, ICU, doctors, bloodBank, lat/lng, contact |
| **Shelter** | name, capacity, occupancy, food/water/power, medicalKits, lat/lng |
| **Volunteer** | name, email, phone, skills, available, assignedDisaster FK, lat/lng |
| **Resource** | type(8 kinds), quantity, available, assignedDisaster FK, location, lat/lng |
| **Drone** | droneId, status(5 states), battery%, camera, missionStatus, assignedDisaster FK, lat/lng |
| **Notification** | user FK, title, message, type(INFO/WARNING/ALERT/SUCCESS), read flag |
| **AuditLog** | action, entityType, entityId, performedBy, details, timestamp |

---

## 🧭 Application Features (Complete Detail)

### 1. 🔐 Authentication & Authorization
- Register with username/email/password
- Login returns JWT (24h expiry)
- JWT stored in `localStorage`, sent via Bearer header
- Auto-redirect to `/login` on 401
- Role-based routes: `adminOnly` prop protects admin pages
- **Seed users:** `admin/admin123` (ADMIN) — `user/user123` (USER)

### 2. 🌪️ Disaster Management
- **8 disaster types:** Flood, Earthquake, Cyclone, Wildfire, Tsunami, Landslide, Drought, Epidemic
- **4 severity levels:** Low, Medium, High, Critical
- **6-status lifecycle:** PENDING → ASSIGNED → IN_PROGRESS → RESOLVED (plus CANCELLED/REPORTED internally)
- Report disaster with type, description, severity, location, lat/lng
- My disasters (user) / All disasters (admin)
- Admin can update any disaster's status via inline dropdown
- Delete (admin), search/filter by status

### 3. 🤖 AI-Powered Insights
- **Damage Prediction** (`AIPredictionService.java:7`): Computes estimated damage level, affected population, economic loss (in ₹), recovery time, and confidence score based on disaster type × severity multiplier
- **Resource Optimization** (`ResourceOptimizationService.java:14`): Recommends quantities for 9 resource types (ambulances, fire trucks, police teams, medical teams, rescue workers, volunteers, boats, helicopters, generators) with natural-language reasoning

### 4. 🗺️ Interactive Live Map
- React Leaflet with 3 map layers: Street (OSM), Terrain (OpenTopoMap), Satellite (ArcGIS)
- Color-coded markers: Red (Critical), Orange (High), Yellow (Medium), Green (Low), Blue (Hospital)
- Shows all entities: disasters, hospitals, shelters, drones
- **Live drone GPS simulation** every 5 seconds via `/api/locations/live`
- Map legend, popup with entity details

### 5. 🚁 Drone Monitoring
- 5 drone statuses: Available, In Mission, Charging, Maintenance, Offline
- 3 mission statuses: Pending, In Progress, Completed
- Battery level with color-coded progress bar (green > 50%, yellow > 20%, red < 20%)
- Camera status indicator, GPS coordinates
- Map view showing drone positions
- Auto-refresh every 10 seconds
- CRUD operations (admin)

### 6. 🏥 Hospital Management
- Track: name, available beds, ICU beds, doctors available, blood bank availability, emergency contact
- Map view of all hospitals
- Full CRUD (admin)

### 7. 🏠 Shelter Management
- Track: capacity, occupancy, food/water/power availability, medical kits
- Occupancy percentage with color bar (green/yellow/red)
- Map view with occupancy-based marker coloring
- Full CRUD (admin)

### 8. 👥 Volunteer Management
- Track: name, email, phone, skills, availability status
- Stats: total, available, deployed counts
- Filter by available/deployed
- Full CRUD (admin)

### 9. 📦 Resource Management
- **8 resource types:** Ambulance, Fire Truck, Police Team, Medical Team, Rescue Team, Boat, Helicopter, Generator
- Inventory grid showing counts per type
- Available vs deployed tracking
- Assign to disaster
- Full CRUD (admin)

### 10. 🔔 Notification System
- In-app notifications with Info/Warning/Alert/Success types
- **Notification bell** in sidebar with unread count badge (polling every 30s)
- Dropdown showing latest unread notifications
- Mark single/all as read
- Full notification center page
- SMS mock (`MockSMSProvider`) + Email mock (`MockEmailProvider`) triggered on disaster create & status change

### 11. 📊 Advanced Analytics
- **12+ metrics:** total disasters, hospitals, shelters, volunteers, resources
- **Time metrics:** average response time (hours), average resolution time (hours)
- **Charts:** monthly trends (line), by type (bar), by severity (bar), by status (pie)
- **Utilization rates:** resource utilization %, volunteer activity %, hospital occupancy %, shelter occupancy %

### 12. 📁 Data Export (Admin Only)
- **CSV** — OpenCSV with proper escaping
- **TXT/PDF** — Formatted text report
- **Excel** — CSV-based (easily swappable to Apache POI)

### 13. 📋 Audit Trail
- Logs all actions: CREATE, STATUS_CHANGE, DELETE
- Records: action, entity type, entity ID, performed by, details, timestamp
- Filterable by username

### 14. 📈 Status Timeline
- Per-disaster status change history
- Tracks: from status → to status, who changed it, comment, timestamp
- Displayed via `TimelineController`

### 15. 🌤️ Weather
- Weather endpoint (mock returns hardcoded data; swap in OpenWeatherMap API key in `application.properties`)

### 16. 🌱 Seed Data
On first startup, the app seeds:
- **2 users** (admin + user)
- **4 disasters** (Flood in Mumbai, Earthquake in Guwahati, Cyclone in Chennai, Wildfire in Dehradun — different statuses)
- **3 hospitals** (Mumbai, Guwahati, Chennai)
- **3 shelters** (same cities, different capacities)
- **3 volunteers** (each with different skills)
- **5 resources** (ambulances, fire trucks, medical teams, boats, helicopter)
- **3 drones** (DRN-001 Available, DRN-002 In Mission, DRN-003 Charging)
